purpose: The tenant convention of every Ottili product repository: one tenant GUC and one tenant column. The RLS checker reads this file instead of hard-coding a name.
canonical_decision: SET by SKL-W1-01 on 2026-10-20. app.company_id is the single tenant GUC and company_id the single tenant column of every Ottili product repository. The names under rejected_names are the measured legacy spellings; they are findings, because no session of the platform sets them, so a policy keyed on one isolates nobody.

rejected_names.name: app.current_company_id
rejected_names.why: legacy spelling of ld3-v2 and alran-clients-v2; the session sets app.company_id, so a policy on this name isolates nobody

rejected_names.name: ottili.company_id
rejected_names.why: spelling of ottili-apps and ottili-platform; the session sets app.company_id, so a policy on this name isolates nobody

rejected_names.name: app.current_company
rejected_names.why: legacy spelling of hq-v2; the session sets app.company_id, so a policy on this name isolates nobody

rejected_names.name: app.current_tenant
rejected_names.why: the tenant column of this platform is company_id; no session of the platform sets app.current_tenant, so a policy on it isolates nobody

known_non_tenant_names.name: ottili.actor_ref
known_non_tenant_names.why: carries the acting subject, not the tenant discriminator

known_non_tenant_names.name: app.current_tenant_key
known_non_tenant_names.why: legacy ottilionev1 tables are keyed on tenant_key, not company_id

known_non_tenant_names.name: app.is_superadmin
known_non_tenant_names.why: role flag, not a tenant discriminator
